title: When the Static Burns
author: Wren Halloran
blurb: Coral Villalobos, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
